csv_agency: Univ of California Davis Health System
csv_scope_of_work: The UC Davis Health, Facilities Planning & Development division is comprised of several teams responsible for the implementation of the health system s Capital Improvement Program in keeping with the Long-Range Development Plan (LRDP). The Capital Infrastructure Team is responsible for project management of capital improvement and expense construction projects of large scope and complexity with prominent significance within the campus, requiring Chancellor approval and involving the direction of multiple high-level design and engineering professionals.
csv_disciplines_requested: Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, ITS Design
title: Construction Management for Capital Infrastructure Projects
short_description: University health system seeks multidisciplinary support for major capital infrastructure projects.
project_scope: On-call or program-level support for UC Davis Health capital improvement and expense construction projects of large scope and complexity under the Capital Improvement Program and Long-Range Development Plan. Projects are described as prominent within the campus, requiring Chancellor approval and coordination of multiple senior design and engineering disciplines. Total stated construction cost is 45,000,000 USD.
services: Construction/project management, cost estimating, inspection services, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, utility engineering, and ITS design.
relevance_explanation:
- University/health campus capital program is strategically adjacent to sbp interests in large institutional developments.
- Structural engineering is included among requested disciplines.
- However, the lead focus is construction/project management and multidisciplinary program support rather than core structural design of a specific complex structure.
- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or architecturally demanding building is identified.
- Health system/infrastructure program scope is broad and nonspecific, limiting direct fit for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice states a total construction cost of 45,000,000 USD and requests multidisciplinary consulting services, but it does not define the structural engineering share, procurement package size, or compensation basis.
references_qualifications: Bidders are sought for multidisciplinary consulting capabilities including construction/project management, cost estimating, inspection, electrical, fire protection, mechanical, structural, utility engineering, and ITS design. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
contracting_authority: University of California Davis Health System, Facilities Planning & Development, Sacramento, CA, USA. Contact: Nicole Quintero. Email: nicquintero@health.ucdavis.edu. Phone: 916-734-7024. Website: https://health.ucdavis.edu/facilities/work-with-us/consultants/rfq
notes: The notice appears to be an RFQ/RFP for capital infrastructure program support rather than a single defined building project. Source labels the project as 'CM for Capital Infrastructure Projects,' indicating a strong construction management component. Solicitation documents are available online.
